senses.gloss: m. pl. (= שבהר׳, v. שַׁבְהַר; cmp. חִיוַּרְוָרַיָּא a. סַנְוֵור) being dazzled, blinking, temporary blindness, loss of direction.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 19:11">Targ. O. Gen. XIX, 11</cite> (ed. Berl. <cite ref="U00184"><he>שַׁבְרָרַיָּא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 6:18">Targ. II Kings VI, 18</cite>.—
<cite ref="Yoma 28b:16">Yoma 28ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ דשמשא וכ׳</he> the dazzling sun-light coming through cracks or breaks in the clouds is worse than the uncovered sun.
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:2">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ דיממא</he> sudden blindness occurring in day-time (from dazzling light).
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ דליליא</he> blindness occurring at night (believed to be caused by a demon living in the water or in water vessels.
Ib. (an incantation for blindness) ש׳ דפלוני וכ׳ shabriré of N, son of N, leave &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 12b:5">Ab. Zar. 12ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 112a:5">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>סכנת ש׳</he> the danger of getting blind (from drinking at night).
Ib. (an incantation against thirst at night) נימא איהו … מש׳ ש׳ ברירי וכ׳ let him say to himself, N, son of N, my [thy] mother told me, be on guard against shabriré: shabriré, b’riré, riré yiré, ré
